WITH monthly_gross_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS month_date,
        ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
),
moed AS (
    SELECT 
        LAG(month_date) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS prev_month,
        month_date,
        gross_revenue,
        gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS mom_increase
    FROM monthly_gross_revenue
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(month_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, mom_increase FROM moed WHERE mom_increase IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mom_increase DESC LIMIT 1

        f1.created_at AS first_created_at,
        f2.created_at AS second_created_at,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f2.created_at - f1.created_at))::numeric AS days_between
